description: GitHub evaluates jobs.<id>.if BEFORE the matrix expands, so the matrix context is unavailable there. Referencing it is invalid and GitHub fails the whole workflow at startup: a run with zero jobs and conclusion=failure, on EVERY push to any branch. seed-corpus.yml did exactly this and produced a permanently red check nobody attributed to a workflow bug (fixed under seed-corpus-workflow-fails-on-every-push). Nothing catches the class: the file is valid YAML so check-yaml passes, and the repo has no actionlint in any lane. A scan of all .github/workflows/*.yml found seed-corpus.yml as the only job-level offender at fix time -- nightly.yml:67 references matrix in a STEP-level if, which is legal -- so this is about preventing recurrence, not clearing a backlog. APPROACH: try actionlint against .github/workflows/ first (it catches this plus a wide family of Actions expression/context errors); wire into the lint job if the baseline is clean or baselineable. Cheap fallback: a parser-level test in tests/unit/workflows/ enumerating jobs.<id>.if across all workflow files and asserting no matrix/strategy reference. SCOPE: .github/workflows/, tests/unit/workflows/, Makefile. PRESERVE: existing workflows keep their triggers and job graphs. VERIFY: uv run -- python -c "import yaml,glob; bad=[(f,j) for f in glob.glob('.github/workflows/*.yml') for j,c in ((yaml.safe_load(open(f)) or {}).get('jobs') or {}).items() if isinstance(c,dict) and 'matrix' in str(c.get('if',''))]; assert not bad, bad; print('ok')" -- prints ok, exit 0. NOTE: guardrail fields are prose here because promote() accepts only title/priority/worktree/description -- see todo-tracker-create-time-only-fields-cannot-be-repaired.
